Title: Solomon, a Man of Rest and Temple Builder
Promise: A son would be born to David who would be a man of rest, with rest from all his enemies, named Solomon, bringing peace and quietness to Israel in his days; he would build a house for God's name, be God's son, and have his kingdom's throne established over Israel for ever.
Fulfillment: Solomon sat on the throne of David and his kingdom was established greatly, as 1 Kings 2:12 records, and he built the house and finished it, as 1 Kings 6:14 records.
